Row percentages are shown to examine differences in the likelihood of having gradable images, based on patient characteristics. All chi-square tests examining likelihood of having gradable versus ungradable images (by characteristic) indicate the 2 groups differ along these characteristics. �3 people were ’other’ for gender and were excluded. ��UWFI became available in this program Sept 2014.
